Cheryl was motivated to run for office by a desire to restore and preserve freedom, which, in her view, has been eroding over her lifetime. Cheryl believes in the worth and dignity of individuals and families and their right and ability to govern their own affairs. She also believes that, for the good of the Republic, civility, wit, and wisdom must return to politics.     Representative Acton believes that while other elected titles (senator, governor, etc.) have lost their original meaning, "Representative" is unambiguous.
